svg.text: U4 PIO host power and cutoff
Protected U2 branch and U1 feed converge at IC8. IC6 protects the selected supply at J4.
Matching rail and remote labels are electrical joins. GND symbols share GND. X marks a deliberate no-connect.
Blue values open manufacturer documents. * Exact manufacturer or order code open.
Published electrical basis dae330c / c664df16. Existing review holds apply.
GP8 requires an independently authorized U2 budget. B-branch settled ceiling is proposed at 200 mA.
Drop GP9 before a source change. Establish the new source and actual VBUS clearance before a fresh attach.
GP9 port veto and enable from HOST_PRE
